routines.semantics: Mutate a caller-owned byte-width character set. Nonempty input replaces its contents with sorted, deduplicated items. Empty input uses the C insertion shortcut.

scenarios.observes: Sort bytewise and remove repeated items before returning the full caller cell.
Repeated blanks and adjacent nonblank separators follow different rules.
The order and multiplicity of delimiter bytes do not change the resulting set.
An empty input inserts an empty member; an all-blank list replaces the old set.
Observe replacement, sorting, duplicates and a subsequent insertion on the same nonempty caller-owned set.
Repeated items may exceed the item count before deduplication while the actual set fits.
Rows of width eight retain seven content bytes; equal truncated prefixes collapse.
UTF-8 scalar sequences and a BOM are retained inside nontruncated rows.
Embedded tab and vertical tab are ordinary bytes unless explicitly designated delimiters.
Absence of a delimiter yields one trimmed or width-limited item.
Trailing and leading delimiters share the same empty member.
An empty C list on a full cell inserts through INSRTC and reports capacity exhaustion.
A nonempty list with zero-length delimiter string returns the CSPICE diagnostic.
An all-blank nonempty list still checks the delimiter length.
A full destination receives distinct tokens past capacity after an early duplicate.
A zero-capacity cell cannot accommodate the one blank member.
The translated character control words need sufficient width.
The C empty-list branch inserts directly and bypasses translated cell controls.

routines.edgeAssessment: Exercise empty and all-blank input, mixed delimiters, narrow and truncated rows, UTF-8, capacity after deduplication, and existing sets.
routines.errorAssessment: Capture the exact toolkit errors on full, zero-capacity, undersized-control and empty delimiter inputs. Compiled wrapper tests independently check wrong owner, type, expiry, embedded NUL, malformed UTF-16 and post-failure state.
routines.fixtureRationale: Authored strings and per-case character cell allocations require no kernels or external data.
routines.cleanup: Native and WASM release owned cells, reset toolkit failures and support cell reuse. Tests inject failure at all three WASM allocation positions and verify balanced ownership.
routines.tolerance: Exact sorted cell rows, integer cardinalities and error short codes. A subsequent insertion distinguishes significant stored trailing whitespace from the existing trimmed display representation.
